games.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
games.summary:
Bringing together a talented team of developers, including members of the core team behind one of the most acclaimed games of all time - The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt along with its expansions, Rebel Wolves’ first title is a dark fantasy narrative sandbox, AAA action-RPG set in medieval Europe.

This brand-new IP is aimed at mature audiences and is powered by Unreal Engine 5.

games.name: Alone With You
games.summary: ALONE WITH YOU is a sci-fi point-and-click adventure game that tells a rich story about relationships. You're the last survivor of a doomed space colony, trying to escape a planet before it implodes around you.

games.name: Asdivine Knot
games.platforms: PS5 · Xbox · Switch 2 · Switch · PC · PS4
games.summary:
A young cleric named Verselio once devoted his life to serving the deity Treises - until the truth shattered everything he believed. 

When the divine is revealed to be a lie, faith turns into fury, and a journey of rebellion begins. Joined by a mysterious maiden, a disciplined vigilante chief, and a self-proclaimed deity, Verselio sets out across a vast fantasy world in search of answers. As their paths intertwine, each carries their own burdens, beliefs, and secrets, in a story of betrayal, redemption, and the meaning of faith in a deityless world.

Asdivine Knot is a classic turn-based JRPG that blends strategic command battles with modern systems and deep customization. Master the shared Nexus Gauge to control the flow of combat, unleash powerful Nexus Skills, and summon devastating entities to turn the tide. Explore a wide world with your fully customizable airship, craft and upgrade equipment using collected materials, and shape your adventure with side quests, crew recruitment, fishing, and puzzle dungeons. 

Packed with rich content and designed for a complete single-player experience, this is a must-play fantasy RPG for fans of traditional Japanese role-playing games.

games.name: BallsCommander
games.summary: Command adorable little balls in quick tactical battles that last just a few minutes. Capture sectors, play solo or against a friend online, protect your mighty Mother Ball, and pretend the rematch was always part of the plan.

games.name: Beetleball - The Beetle Billionaire's Deluxe Golden Scarab Supporter Pack
BioEden
games.summary:
Welcome to BioEden, a cozy management game where you will build a self-sustaining network of structures, all working in harmony to bring extinct animals back to life. As a Keeper, you have been entrusted by the Cosmic Collective to bring life back to a planet quietly waiting to be healed. 

Upon your arrival, search for debris sites scattered across the land, they are the foundation of your journey. Recycle them into resources, and use those to build the base of your network: a solar energy system to generate electricity, and a water system to distribute it across all your buildings. Connect them together, weave a network across the land, and manage the supply and demand for every structure you create.

But plan with care. Each addition to your planet consumes resources, draws on energy, and nudges pollution upward. Find the balance between creation, exploration, and restraint, to accomplish the very mission that brought you here.

games.name: Bubblecore: Survivors
games.summary: Bubblecore: Survivors is an endless hex-grid tower defense roguelite. Pop bubbles to claim resources—and unleash the monsters trapped inside. Build towers, collect artifacts, create powerful synergies, and defend the Citadel while deciding how much risk to take.

games.name: Cloudgazer: A Game About Watching Clouds
games.summary: A game about watching clouds. Discover hundreds of hidden shapes, train your pareidolia, and let your imagination do the rest.

games.name: Corpo Revenge
games.summary: Corpo Revenge is a 2D Top-Down shooter with handcrafted levels. Play as Martin seeking revenge of the evil energy drink corporation who poisoned his son. Shoot your way through evil guards and avoid hitting innocent office workers on your way to the corrupted CEO.

games.name: Droppy Dog
games.summary: Merge cute dogs, chain combos, and reach the legendary K-ing Dog! Droppy Dog is a cozy puzzle-merge game with 12 adorable dog breeds, a lifesaving broom power, and satisfying chain reactions. Perfect for a relaxing session — or a scoreboard-chasing marathon.

games.name: Escape Matrix
games.summary: Escape Matrix is a first-person logic puzzle and escape room game. Trapped in an abstract reality, you must find, carry, and place mathematical symbols to complete calculus equations on the walls. Reconstruct the formulas, unlock the security doors, and escape the simulation!

games.name: Floor Zero
games.summary: An atmospheric anomaly horror game set inside a mysterious hospital. Observe your surroundings, identify anomalies, survive deadly Threat encounters, and reach Floor Zero.

games.name: Hardcore Sniper
games.summary: A realistic sniping game focused on long-range precision shooting. Estimate range, compensate for wind, calculate bullet trajectory, and deliver lethal shots from hundreds of yards away.

games.name: Hashire Hebereke: EX
games.summary:
Hashire HEBEREKE: EX is a modern remake of the 1994 Super Famicom game Hashire Hebereke by SUNSOFT.

Players can choose from a cast of quirky and adorable characters to race through item-filled, obstacle-packed courses. Local multiplayer supports up to four players, while online multiplayer supports up to eight players, ensuring fun and frantic competition.

games.name: HUG & BETRAY
games.summary: Hug, or betray. A psychological party game where everyone picks HUG, Sword, or Gun as the host calls each round. Taunt, bluff, and rack up points! A new kind of viewer-participation game — watch the stream, play from your phone! Who'll be the sore loser howling at the moon?

games.name: I WILL BE THERE: Remastered Edition Demo
Idle Heroes: Three Kingdoms
games.summary: 《挂机吧三国》是一款颠覆传统、融合策略与冒险的三国题材卡牌手游，正等待着您的加入！每一位三国英雄，每一场经典战役，都将以全新的卡牌形式，为您呈现一场前所未有的策略挑战。

games.name: Incremedieval
games.summary: An Incremental game about looting dungeons & becoming stronger

games.name: jigsaw-puzzle
games.summary: SUDOKU Game.

games.name: King Quest
games.summary: Star Link Chinese is an interesting Chinese words game. It aims at testing the gamers' knowledge on Chinese words. At the very beginning, a Chinese Character will be randomly generated as the first character. A number of characters that can link with the character aforementioned will be shown. The gamer has to choose the correct characters to form a word. Note that the last character of the word formed will become the first character again in the next round of the game. Once a correct word is formed, the game time will increase. Therefore, the game is testing how many Chinese words you can form within the game time limit.There is one special issue about the game. Within one game round, you may find several word combinations possibility. Since the last character of the word formed will become the first character again in the next round, you have to think carefully before making such a selection. Especially, when you can choose which word to be formed. It is because some characters are difficult or impossible to form a word again if they are used as the first character. Once such a case happen, the only result is game over. Hence, no matter you are a novice or you have some knowledge on chinese words/characters, this game is very challenging. Especially, we aim at forming a link of chinese characters as long as possible. We strongly hope that this game not even increases your knowledge on chinese words, but also bring along with happiness and self-satisfaction. Enjoy. -------------------------------------------------- Our Chinese Game Series: 1. Chinese Character Fly ! Chinese Character Fly 2 (~500 Selected Chinese Characters, More game elements included. Suitable for beginner to intermediate level users) (USD $1.99)http://itunes.apple.com/app/id5923989443. games.name: Macchinato
games.summary: A relaxing idle clicker about building a coffee empire. Harvest beans, roast them, and serve caffeinated drinks for profit. Automate each stage, work around your bottleneck, and franchise into a global brand. Designed to run alongside your day, and progress keeps brewing while you're away.

games.name: Marsupilami 2 - Salsa Palombia
games.summary: A strange melody has swept across Palombia… and suddenly every animal starts dancing wildly, throwing the jungle into total chaos! Behind this rhythmic madness lurks the Mummy Queen, back from the Underworld with her crew to deliver a cursed concert with devastating effects. To restore peace to the jungle, take control of the three young Marsus, each with their own signature ability. Twister shoots through the air with a turbo glide, Hope leaps forward with an energetic spinning jump, and Punch bounces with powerful force to knock aside anything in his path! Switch instantly from one Marsu to another to unleash their powers and chain together stylish moves. And for even more fun, share the adventure with a friend thanks to local co‑op mode! From the Jungle to the City, from Snowy Mountains to the mysterious Underworld…explore four enchanting worlds packed with surprises, challenges, and unique gameplay mechanics. Beyond the main adventure, take on the Flow Mode, a speed-focused challenge where you must complete a series of trials without dying to prove your skills! And for even more fun, challenge your friends in competitive dojos.

games.name: Mashumaro Trigger!
games.summary: Mashiro has marshmallow-soft cheeks, and her big sister Mio absolutely adores her. Ordinary days—days that come only once—and the precious moments hidden inside them. A slice-of-life novel about the happy chaos of two sisters. A sweet, marshmallow-soft little while, just for you.

games.name: MOO-A-DOODLE-DOO
games.summary: Moo-a-doodle-doo is a hide-and-seek game where you transform into various animals or objects to run away from the Seeker. The three roles—Seeker, Hider, and Trickster—come together to offer a new form of fun. Cause confusion with your modulated voice and stay hidden until the end!

games.name: NBA 2K27
games.summary: Nothing is out of reach for Victor Wembanyama, including becoming the face of the league. The reigning Defensive Player of the Year is shattering records at an unprecedented pace, and his talent can only be described as otherworldly. The future has arrived and it’s on the cover of NBA 2K27. Caitlin Clark is changing the game with her limitless range, but it’s her will to win that’s fueled her rapid ascent from college phenom to WNBA superstar. Clark holds the all-time NCAA Division I scoring record for both men and women, is a No. 1 overall pick, Rookie of the Year, two-time All-Star, and the ultimate competitor. Take the court with NBA 2K27 Deluxe Edition and make every possession a viral highlight. He started with a dream on the South Side of Chicago, and built a legacy that inspired the world. Derrick Rose is the youngest MVP in NBA history, a three-time All-Star, an icon on and off the court, and an NBA 2K cover star. Celebrate his career with NBA 2K27 Ultra Edition and follow in his footsteps as you lead an NBA franchise.[2K Sports]

games.name: NodeFantasy - A Path-Connecting Management RPG
games.summary: In a beautiful, melancholic world, connect cards with a line and carve your path through the dungeon. Success hinges on management: how you allocate stats, where you connect, what class you choose. Explore, farm, mine, and trade to raise your people, or use them up. Unravel the mystery within.

games.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
games.summary:
Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice. With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.

Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.

Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

games.name: PegPot
games.summary: Survive 9 increasingly difficult rounds by clearing all red pegs and clearing the score requirement. Each new round will have more red pegs and higher score requirements. Use your 9 initial balls to clear them out!

games.name: Primal Clicker: Build, Hunt, Explore
games.summary: Based on the old paper and pencil game, Dots. Sneaky Dots has you plot points on a grid to surround as many enemy dots as you can.

games.name: Roads of Da Vinci: In Search of Origins
Shoe it All!
games.summary: Launch shoes from a swing to solve clever physics puzzles. Master trick shots, uncover hidden secrets and discover smarter solutions with fewer throws.

games.name: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed
games.summary:
SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed is a fast-paced competitive platformer and a sequel to one of the most beloved indie games of the 2010s. Pick a character of your choice from a vibrant cast of eccentric superheroes, both returning and new, and face off against your rivals in frenetic running races for up to 8 players per lobby, locally or online.

The original multiplayer gameplay formula of SpeedRunners is timeless, unofficially dubbed as the ‘Mario Kart of 2D platformers’. With the sequel, our goal is to carefully bring this unique ‘SpeedRunners feel’ into the new era without compromising on the depth and fluidity of the movement system while still keeping it easy to grasp. On top of that, King of Speed introduces vibrant high-definition graphics and improved netcode.

games.name: Tiny Turnip DX
games.summary: Help a turnip reach the stars in this award-winning 1-bit metroidvania!

games.name: Tofush
games.summary: ToFush is a 2D arena survival game where tofu characters push back waves of enemies and survive by combining a variety of items. Hold your ground, avoid being knocked out of the arena, and grow stronger to send your enemies flying!

games.name: Twister City
games.summary: Twister City is an online co-op game featuring proximity chat, where you and up to 5 friends try to survive in a city plagued by tornadoes. Collect debris to research for points and unlock new items and upgrades that will hopefully increase your chances to survive Twister City.

games.name: Vale Primordial
games.summary: A meteor wiped out the age of giants — but one egg survived. Feed it, hatch new species, and bring the valley back to life. A dinosaur idle game with 10 species, 100 hunting upgrades, 40 talents, and an extinction cycle that restarts everything, stronger.

games.name: Waiting for You in Hell
games.summary: A dark romantic visual novel featuring Lilith, a hellish nun, as the sole heroine. Spend seven days with your sharp-tongued yet ever-present jailer, moving through judgment, banter, and shared moments, gradually uncovering the side of her she never shows to others.

games.name: ZONE 47
games.summary: ZONE 47 is an atmospheric checkpoint inspector simulator set in a quarantined exclusion zone. Inspect documents, uncover contraband, survive deadly emissions, and decide who gets through—and who is turned away.

games.name: Arxanum Idle
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a medieval fantasy world inspired by many other great idle titles. Follow the story as a fallen deity and reclaim your lost power after being betrayed by your fellow Guardians.

games.name: Blackwire
games.summary: Blackwire is a single-player hacking simulation in the spirit of the classics. You are a freelance agent with a gateway, a contract board, and a trace timer that does not care how close you were to done.Take contracts from fictional corporations, copy files, empty an account, rewrite a criminal record, put someone in prison. Build a bounce route a dozen hops long before you touch the target, because every hop you put between yourself and them is time on the clock when they notice you. And they will notice you.Then get out, and clean up after yourself. Their admins walk your log trail hop by hop, and the entry that names your gateway is sitting on the first server you bounced through. Scrubbing it is not a side activity. It is how you stay alive.FEATURESA living network — hundreds of servers, banks, registries, and mainframes. Every machine keeps logs. Every log can hang you.The trace is the game — an active countdown while you work, a passive investigation after you leave. Outrun one, erase the other.Follow the money — crack a bank account and chase stolen funds through chains of transfers, or wire someone else's credits to yourself.Mainframes — crawl their internal interface lock by lock towards root, past scanners, ICE, and counter-intrusion hardware that hacks you back.Build your rig — mainboards, cpus, drives, and a catalogue of software from bruteforce to ghost. Split your CPU between the crack and the shield and hope you split it right.Two corporations at war — both want to hire you against the other. Both pay well. Both remember.A story that finds you — someone is clearing freelance agents off the board, one by one. Your name is on a list you have to steal to read.Entirely offline. No accounts, no server, nothing real — a game about the fantasy of hacking, the way it looked in the movies and never was.

games.name: Carriers Together
games.summary: A 2–6 player co-op puzzle game where you carry and throw each other to solve clever puzzles. Coordinate your timing, work as a team, and clear every stage.

games.name: Desktop Tiny Tides
games.summary: Turn your desktop into a living fishing world. Drag your boat across the screen, discover 144 different fish, cast your line wherever they swim, complete timing-based fishing, upgrade your equipment, and build your collection.

games.name: Escape from Company
games.summary: A puzzle escape game set in a company that won’t let you quit. Solve challenging puzzles, overcome absurd workplace rules, and escape with your resignation.

games.name: Football Legacy Manager 27
games.summary: Build the ultimate legacy as the general manager of a professional American football team!

games.name: Fortress Merge
games.summary: Merge buildings, upgrade your defenses, and protect your fortress from endless waves of zombies. Plan each move carefully, adapt your strategy, and survive as long as you can.

games.name: Hockey Beasts
games.summary: Hockey Beasts is a colorful, casual hockey game about a group of unlikely animal teams trying to prove who belongs at the top of the league.

games.name: Isle of Reveries
games.summary: Make a pilgrimage skybound to the Isle of Reveries, where any wish can be granted. Conquer mysterious dungeons, solve puzzles, and explore a vast overworld in this retro-inspired adventure.

games.name: Kitty Needs A Home!
games.summary: A cozy idle game about a shelter for cats. Catch fluffballs in the yard, fulfill heartwarming requests from around the world, collect an album of happy endings — and win Jane's heart. Cuteness, pixels, and purring. Plays itself while you're away!

games.name: Motelet
games.summary: Motelet is an incremental game about cleaning dusty rooms with a cute robot vacuum. Clear away dust and debris, earn coins, and purchase powerful upgrades as you transform your humble cleaner into the ultimate cleaning machine.

games.name: Order Automatica
games.summary:
Order Automatica is a dark tactical roguelite where automated battles are won before they even begin.

Build deadly synergies on a small 3x3 ritual grid, position your units carefully, manipulate tiles, and prepare for brutal encounters against demonic enemies. Every move matters.

games.name: Paleo Dive
games.summary: A calm VR diving adventure through prehistoric underwater worlds. Explore coral reefs, kelp forests and the deep sea, gather finds and upgrade your gear at your own pace. VR only (OpenXR).

games.name: Phantom PHANTOM OF INFERNO NITRO ARCHIVE
Poggers' Revenge!
games.summary: The wolf pack is hunting you. All you have is rocks. Shove them into walls and box every wolf in — each one you trap leaves a carrot worth grabbing, if you dare. A fast arcade puzzler in the spirit of old school casual commercial games, with endless levels that get meaner every time you clear one.

games.name: Pomoroid
games.summary: A Pomodoro timer & calendar app where a character you made cheers you on and even chats with you via AI whenever you need to focus. Freely customize everything from Pomodoro backgrounds to to-do management, alarms, and stickers, then share your cheer packs and alarm packs with others on the Workshop

games.name: Stellar End
games.summary: "Your ship has just been repaired! Fight your way through numerous trails. This system really needs your help!" Cool combination of classic Sci-Fi 2D "Shoot 'em up" with 3D FPP on-rails shooter. Weaponry system is gradually getting quite complex, dogfights are quite addictive and challenging.

games.name: VOXEL ISLE SIMULATOR
games.summary: Raise an island from the sea, seed it with life, then smite it, flood it, or raise its dead. A voxel god game where tribes you never command learn masonry and gunpowder, forge kingdoms and go to war, and every power you use is written into a history you can click to visit.

games.name: Wyrdwic: At the Heart of a New World
Panda Fishing: The Way of Angling
Memnon: Give Your Games a Voice
Bus Simulator 27
games.summary:
Get ready for Bus Simulator 27, the most advanced entry in the history of the franchise. Look forward to our most comprehensive bus fleet yet - with new officially licensed brands and models, as well as iconic buses from the series.

Explore a vibrant new open world inspired by the Iberian Peninsula, featuring distinct districts, busy streets, and impressive landmarks - all brought to life with Unreal Engine 5.

Whether you're behind the wheel, walking the streets or riding as a passenger, the city is yours to discover. Plan custom routes and manage your growing business.

Play solo or team up with friends in 4-player co-operative mode.

games.name: Desk Top Racer — Crate Storage Expansion
Desk Top Racer — Premium Car Pack
Halloween: The Game
games.summary:
It’s Halloween night, 1978, the unsuspecting families of the quiet suburban town of Haddonfield are making holiday preparations, and evil has made its way home. Take The Shape of Evil as Michael Myers or save your neighbors as a Hero of Haddonfield in Halloween, the ultimate asymmetrical horror sandbox. 

As Michael, players wear the mask, become the Boogeyman, and stalk innocent residents with relentless obsession. Utilizing a nightmarish array of abilities, Michael leverages shadows and stealth to satisfy his bloodthirst. This doesn’t mean Haddonfield is going down without a fight. Frightened townsfolk will call the local authorities and even fight back when threatened, incentivizing Michael to avoid detection. And for the first time ever, fans of the transformative original film will have the option to witness the haunting narrative events surrounding "The Night He Came Home" through the eyes of Michael Myers in a standalone singleplayer story mode.

As a Hero of Haddonfield, it’s your job to alert the residents of Haddonfield to the impending evil and help them escape before falling victim to Michael’s unyielding pursuit. In dynamic and ever-changing 1v4 asymmetrical multiplayer matches, hero players must arm themselves with everyday household items, weapons, and knowledge to combat an unpredictable and unkillable enemy.

games.name: Honeycomb: The World Beyond
games.summary: Honeycomb: The World Beyond is a survival-sandbox game set on an exuberant planet – Sota7. Explore its vast world and face challenges on your bioengineering journey. Crossbreed plants or animals, gather resources, craft items, and conduct experiments in order to develop new species.

games.name: Of Nooks and Nonsense: A Pirate Hidden Object Game
SPRAWL zero
games.summary: SPRAWL zero is a fast-paced shooter inspired by the Golden Age of 2000s FPS. Survive a brutal cyberpunk city collapsing under military rule and cult fanaticism. Use your Gravity-Gloves, augments, and an arsenal of over 40 weapons to crush those who stand in your way.

games.name: Surviving Mars: Relaunched - Feeding the Future
games.summary:
Your colonists are hungry for more than survival. Provide your colonists with various delicacies and build local production to create the ultimate Martian diet in Surviving Mars: Relaunched — Feeding the Future.

After all, survival comes in many flavors!

games.name: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster
games.summary:
After the brief peace that followed the wars of the portals that devastated the country, new winds of war threaten its inhabitants when the new king of Imperia together with the Sacred Kingdom have started a war against non-humans, using the services of one of the Last Wizards of Arborea: Trece XIII and their generals, it is the moment of the prophecy, a chosen one will unite Men and beasts to bring peace.

A classic hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania action game. Use your Beastmaster skills to unleash your inner beast, fight with your heart-devouring sword and end the threat to Arborea.

games.name: Black Friday Janitor: Clean the Whole Mall
Caribbean Legend: Age of Pirates - Buccaneers
Detective VR
games.summary:
DETECTIVE VR is a narrative investigation game for Meta Quest 3 & 3S: You can control time, collect clues and interview witnesses in Passthrough. The investigation takes place in your living room.

Explore unreliable testimonies and confront suspects to find out what happened!

A mix between ObraDinn/Immortality and Minority Report: An innovative way to tell a story in Mixed Reality.

Les aventures extraordinaires d'Alec Orbusier - Acte 1 : Le Tombeau de Taâl Rash'a Demo
The Legend of Fancy Realm Remake
The Things We Don't See: 10 Interactive Stories of Horror, Mystery, and the Unknown
Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil

A Night at Moka Efti: A Babylon Berlin Story
Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition - The Baltic Powers
Burgie's cozy kitchen - Dungeon cosmetics pack
Dumb Ways to Build
games.summary: Dumb Ways to Build is a chaotic, physics-based co-op game. Team up with friends to assemble your crew and take-on dangerous construction jobs. With all the gear and no idea, work together to build your path forward, or die trying!

games.name: Ghost in the SQL Data Demo
Hazard Pay
games.summary:
The job is simple: destroy evidence. Leave no trace. Don’t die in the process.

Hazard Pay is a pixel-art block-pushing puzzler set in a crumbling dystopian world. You’ll navigate alone through abandoned and contaminated facilities, dodging environmental hazards while completing your employer’s checklist with calculated efficiency.

games.name: HimaNatsu: Of Churches, Sunflowers, and Long Summers
Hitherto: School of Swordcery and Shieldjuration
Hot Wheels Infinite Rush
games.summary:
Race beyond the orange track and jump into a Hot Wheels™-sized world with four islands to explore, each with its own vibe and challenges. Roam freely through a world full of adventures, smash obstacles, discover secret items, and take on epic activities.

BECOME THE RUSH MASTER
Each island is ruled by a Rush Master – the ultimate boss to defeat. Complete events to unlock their challenge, and beat them to claim their car and title. Once you've conquered all four, be crowned the one true Rush Master!

PICK YOUR RIDE
Master four unique vehicle types: all-out Versatiles, massive Titans, agile Drifters, and lightning-fast Speeders. Each offers a different way to race. Choose your favorite rides, build your Rush Squad, and get ready for any challenge. And don't stop there: show off by customizing your car, right down to the wheels!

A COLLECTION LIKE NO OTHER
Discover and collect 150+ vehicles through events, activities, and challenges. Unlock rare models, fill your garage, and hit the road with some of the most iconic Hot Wheels™ out there.

MAKE THE WORLD YOUR TRACK
With the new Track Builder, create next-level tracks using the world around you. Attach modules to the ground, build around buildings, or race above the city, weaving around towering skyscrapers.

ENDLESS FUN
Take on a variety of game modes including single-player, split-screen with up to four players, and online multiplayer with full cross-play*. Climb the leaderboards, prove your skills, and race your way to the top!

games.name: I Need to Fix My Dream Car (But I Work at a Junkyard)
The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline
games.summary: The world knows the Divine Comedy as a poem. For your family, it is a prison. As Gabriele Alighieri, you inherit a duty: reseal the gates of Hell. Burdened by fate, you descend into a psychological nightmare where the only escape is to uncover the dark secrets of your ancestors.

A Vila Sobre o Poço Demo
Fire and Water: Spirits of the Forest
Heads Will Roll: Reforged - Revenge of the Black Prince

Project Motor Racing: V8 Power Pack
Train Sim World 7
games.summary: Live life on the tracks and discover the joy of train simulation. Whether looking for a relaxing run on the rails or seeking the thrill of mastering your virtual train driver career, find your way in Train Sim World 7.

games.name: CONTROL Resonant
games.summary:
With Control, we leaped into the unknown. We wanted to create something new. Something different and unexpected. A world like no other. 

With Control 2, we'll take another leap into the unknown. It'll be an unexpected journey.

games.name: Silent Hill: Townfall
games.summary: SILENT HILL: Townfall, a co-production with Annapurna Interactive (Stray) and multiple BAFTA award winning No Code Studios (Stories Untold, Observation).

games.name: Gears of War: E-Day
games.summary:
Experience the brutal horror of Emergence Day through the eyes of Marcus Fenix in the origin story of one of gaming's most acclaimed sagas.​ 

Fourteen years before Gears of War, war heroes Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago return home to face a new nightmare: the Locust Horde. These subterranean monsters, grotesque and relentless, erupt from below, laying siege on humanity itself. ​

Built from the ground up with Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers unprecedented graphical fidelity.
